2608.24228.title: Evaluating Multiple LLM Generations with Validated Task Coverage
2608.24228.paper_summary: Many LLM applications are most useful when they provide several candidate outputs for comparison, validation, or combination. Predominant evaluation settings, however, still focus on individual outputs or reduce multiple samples to a single success or selected answer. This can miss whether the outputs include several genuinely different useful results. We introduce VTC-Bench, a five-domain benchmark for this setting, together with Validated Task Coverage (VTC) as its core evaluation quantity. The benchmark is built from carefully selected real-data tasks where both output quality and task-relevant distinctness can be checked automatically and reproducibly, without model-based judges. VTC measures how many distinct useful results are obtained within $k$ attempts. Across multiple models and inference settings, the benchmark leads to different conclusions from conventional evaluation: configurations that look strongest from single-draw quality are not necessarily those with the best coverage, and simple measures of output variation do not reliably recover task-relevant coverage. These results show that finite candidate sets can be evaluated directly as objects of interest, revealing differences in model behavior that are not apparent from conventional per-output evaluation.
2608.24228.paper_summary_zh: 許多大型語言模型應用在提供多個候選輸出以供比較、驗證或結合時最為有用。然而，主要的評估設定仍然專注於單個輸出，或將多個樣本簡化為單一成功或選定答案。這可能會忽略輸出是否包含幾個真正不同且有用的結果。我們介紹了 VTC-Bench，一個針對這一設定的五個領域基準，並將經過驗證的任務覆蓋率（VTC）作為其核心評估指標。該基準是由精心選擇的真實數據任務構建而成，這些任務的輸出質量和任務相關的獨特性可以自動且可重複地檢查，而無需基於模型的評判者。VTC 衡量在 $k$ 次嘗試中獲得多少個不同的有用結果。在多個模型和推理設定中，該基準得出的結論與傳統評估截然不同：從單次抽樣質量看起來最強的配置不一定是那些具有最佳覆蓋率的配置，而輸出變異的簡單衡量方法也無法可靠地恢復任務相關的覆蓋率。這些結果顯示，有限的候選集可以作為關注對象直接進行評估，揭示出模型行為中的差異，而這些差異在傳統的逐輸出評估中並不明顯。
2608.24228.author: Florian Le Bronnec et.al.
